bmo1-2025-q1.summary: For $3\le n\le12$, decide when $n$ distinct positive integers can be placed on a circle so that two of them are comparable by divisibility (one divides the other) exactly when they are neighbours.
bmo1-2025-q1.summaryZh: 对于 $3\le n\le12$，判断何时能够把 $n$ 个不同的正整数排成一圈，使两个数中有一个整除另一个，当且仅当它们在圈上相邻。

methods.title: Orient the cycle and construct its peaks
methods.titleZh: 给圆环定向并构造峰值
steps: For $n=3$, the values $1,2,4$ work since every pair is adjacent. For $n\ge4$, direct each edge from the divisor to its multiple. Two successive edges cannot form a directed path: the two endpoints would then be non-neighbours, yet comparable by transitivity. The directions must alternate, hence $n$ is even.
For $n=2k$, $k\ge2$, take distinct primes $p_1,\ldots,p_k,r_1,\ldots,r_k$. List the $p_i$ in cyclic order and insert $p_ip_{i+1}r_i$ between $p_i$ and $p_{i+1}$ (indices modulo $k$).

A prime divides precisely its two adjacent products. Two different primes do not divide each other. Nor can two products divide one another, since each has a private factor $r_i$. For $k=2$ the private factors also keep the two products distinct. Thus all the listed even sizes work.
stepsZh: $n=3$ 时取 $1,2,4$ 即可，因为任意两个数都相邻。对于 $n\ge4$，每条边由约数指向倍数。连续两条边不能构成有向路径，否则其两个端点虽不相邻，却由整除的传递性而可比。因此边的方向必须交替，$n$ 必为偶数。
设 $n=2k,k\ge2$，取两两不同的素数 $p_1,\ldots,p_k,r_1,\ldots,r_k$。按圆周排列 $p_i$，在 $p_i,p_{i+1}$ 之间插入 $p_ip_{i+1}r_i$，下标循环。
每个 $p_i$ 恰整除其相邻两项。不同素数互不整除，不同乘积也因各有专属素因子 $r_i$ 而互不整除。$k=2$ 时这两个专属因子还保证两个乘积不同。由此完成偶数情形的构造。

bmo1-2025-q2.summary: Arrange the cards $1,\ldots,n$ in advance. Starting with any integer $x$, each card of value $c$ replaces the current number $s$ by $c-s$. Determine which positive integers $n$ allow an order whose final number always equals $-x$.
bmo1-2025-q2.summaryZh: 预先排列标有 $1,\ldots,n$ 的卡片。从任意整数 $x$ 开始，每翻到数值 $c$，就把当前数 $s$ 换成 $c-s$。求哪些正整数 $n$ 能通过同一种排列，使最终数恒为 $-x$。

methods.title: Track the sign and extend by four cards
methods.titleZh: 跟踪符号，每次补四张牌
steps: After $n$ cards the coefficient of $x$ is $(-1)^n$, and the constant is a signed sum of the cards. Hence $n$ must be odd and the positive and negative groups must have the same sum. In particular the total $n(n+1)/2$ is even. For odd $n$ this forces $n\equiv3\pmod4$.
For three cards, use the order $1,3,2$, which sends $x$ to $-x$. Given a valid order of length $n$, append $n+1,n+2,n+4,n+3$ in this order.
The four additional steps leave every incoming value unchanged: the added constant is $-(n+1)+(n+2)-(n+4)+(n+3)=0$ and the sign is positive again. This constructs an order for every $n\equiv3\pmod4$.
stepsZh: 翻完 $n$ 张牌后，$x$ 的系数为 $(-1)^n$，常数部分是各张牌的带符号和。因此 $n$ 必为奇数，且正号与负号两组的数字和相等。于是总和 $n(n+1)/2$ 为偶数，对于奇数 $n$，这要求 $n\equiv3\pmod4$。
三张牌按 $1,3,2$ 排列，可把 $x$ 变为 $-x$。若已有 $n$ 张牌的可行顺序，在末尾依次加入 $n+1,n+2,n+4,n+3$。
这四步的新增常数为 $-(n+1)+(n+2)-(n+4)+(n+3)=0$，而符号又翻正，因此保持进入这四步前的数值不变。由此得到每个 $n\equiv3\pmod4$ 的构造。

bmo1-2025-q3.summary: Two players alternate starting from $10^6$, with Rhian first. From $n$, choose unequal positive factors $a,b$ with $ab=n$ and replace $n$ by their absolute difference. A player without a legal move loses. Who can force a win?
bmo1-2025-q3.summaryZh: 两名玩家从 $10^6$ 开始轮流行动，Rhian 先行。每次从当前数 $n$ 选取两个不相等的正因数 $a,b$，使 $ab=n$，并用二者之差的绝对值替换 $n$。不能行动者输。谁能保证获胜？

methods.title: Leave an odd number on every turn
steps: If $n$ is even, take $1,n$. They are different, and the result $n-1$ is odd. From an odd $n>1$, every factor pair consists of odd numbers, so every legal move leaves a positive even number.
All legal moves strictly decrease $n$: for $1\le a<b$ the difference $b-a$ lies between 1 and $ab-1$. Every $n>1$ has the legal pair $1,n$, so 1 is the only terminal position.
Since $10^6$ is even, Rhian can leave an odd number on every turn. Jack must return an even number whenever he can move. The game must finish, and the terminal odd value 1 is therefore left for Jack.
stepsZh: 若 $n$ 为偶数，选取 $1,n$ 即可；两数不同，且所得 $n-1$ 为奇数。由奇数 $n>1$ 分解得到的两因数都是奇数，所以任何合法一步都会留下一个正偶数。
每一步都严格变小：若 $1\le a<b$，则 $1\le b-a\le ab-1$。任何 $n>1$ 都能取 $1,n$，所以只有 1 是终止局面。
起点 $10^6$ 为偶数，Rhian 每回合都能交给对方一个奇数，而 Jack 如果能走，就只能交回偶数。游戏必定结束，不能走的奇数 1 将留给 Jack。

bmo1-2025-q4.summary: In an acute triangle $ABC$ with $AB<AC<BC$, let $M$ be the midpoint of $BC$. A point $P$ on segment $AM$ satisfies $CP=AB$ and $\angle BAP=\angle BCP$. Show that $PB$ and $PC$ are perpendicular.
bmo1-2025-q4.summaryZh: 锐角三角形 $ABC$ 的边长满足 $AB<AC<BC$。设 $M$ 为 $BC$ 的中点，点 $P$ 在线段 $AM$ 上，且 $CP=AB$、$\angle BAP=\angle BCP$。证明 $PB\perp PC$。
bmo1-2025-q4.answer: $P$ is on the circle with diameter $BC$, so $\angle CPB=90^\circ$.
bmo1-2025-q4.answerZh: $P$ 在以 $BC$ 为直径的圆上，因此 $\angle CPB=90^\circ$。

methods.title: Reflect across the midpoint to obtain an isosceles triangle
methods.titleZh: 关于中点作中心对称，构造等腰三角形
steps: We have $P\ne M$: at $M$ the angle $BCP$ would be zero, whereas $\angle BAM>0$. Let $D$ be the reflection of $A$ in $M$. The same half-turn carries $B$ to $C$, so $CD=AB=CP$. Along the median the order is $D,M,P,A$.

Thus $\angle CDP=\angle DPC$ in isosceles triangle $DCP$. The rays $DP$ and $DC$ are opposite in direction to $AP$ and $AB$, respectively, so $\angle CDP=\angle BAP$. Also $PD$ is the same ray as $PM$, and $CB$ the same ray as $CM$. The given angle equality now reads $\angle MPC=\angle MCP$.
Consequently $MP=MC=MB$, so the circle centred at $M$ through $B,C$ contains $P$. The inscribed angle subtending diameter $BC$ is right.
stepsZh: $P$ 不可能是 $M$，否则 $\angle BCP=0$ 而 $\angle BAM>0$。将 $A$ 关于 $M$ 作中心对称得 $D$。同一变换将 $B$ 映到 $C$，故 $CD=AB=CP$。中线所在直线上各点依次为 $D,M,P,A$。
三角形 $DCP$ 为等腰三角形，故 $\angle CDP=\angle DPC$。射线 $DP,DC$ 的方向分别与 $AP,AB$ 相反，所以 $\angle CDP=\angle BAP$。又 $PD$ 与 $PM$ 为同一射线，$CB$ 与 $CM$ 为同一射线。由题设角相等，得 $\angle MPC=\angle MCP$。
于是 $MP=MC=MB$，点 $P$ 在以 $M$ 为圆心且经过 $B,C$ 的圆上。直径 $BC$ 所对的圆周角为直角。

methods.title: Use the sine rule on opposite sides of the median
methods.titleZh: 对中线两侧的三角形使用正弦定理
steps: Since $P=M$ would contradict $\angle BAP=\angle BCP$, the triangles $ABM$ and $CPM$ are nondegenerate. At $M$, $MA$ and $MP$ are the same ray while $MB$ and $MC$ are opposite. Hence $\angle AMB$ and $\angle PMC$ have the same sine. Also $\angle BAM=\angle MCP$ by hypothesis.

The sine rule gives $BM/AB=\sin\angle BAM/\sin\angle AMB$ and $PM/CP=\sin\angle MCP/\sin\angle PMC$. The ratios agree, and $AB=CP$, so $PM=BM=CM$. The circle with diameter $BC$ therefore passes through $P$, giving $PB\perp PC$.
stepsZh: 若 $P=M$ 会与 $\angle BAP=\angle BCP$ 矛盾，故 $ABM,CPM$ 均为非退化三角形。在 $M$ 处，$MA$ 与 $MP$ 为同一射线，$MB$ 与 $MC$ 方向相反。因此 $\angle AMB$ 与 $\angle PMC$ 互补，正弦相等。题设还给出 $\angle BAM=\angle MCP$。
两次使用正弦定理，得 $BM/AB=\sin\angle BAM/\sin\angle AMB$ 及 $PM/CP=\sin\angle MCP/\sin\angle PMC$。两个比值相等，再由 $AB=CP$ 得 $PM=BM=CM$。于是 $P$ 在以 $BC$ 为直径的圆上，故 $PB\perp PC$。

figure.alt: P lies on median AM. Segments BP and CP are drawn. Matching marks show AB = CP and BM = MC.
figure.altZh: P 在中线 AM 上。连接 BP 与 CP，相同刻痕分别表示 AB=CP、BM=MC。

bmo1-2025-q5.summary: Fix a prime $p$, and let $n$ be the first integer greater than $1$ whose sixth power is congruent to $1$ modulo $p$. Prove that another integer with this property occurs among $n+1,n+2$.
bmo1-2025-q5.summaryZh: 固定素数 $p$。在所有六次方模 $p$ 余 $1$ 的整数中，令 $n$ 为大于 $1$ 的最小者。证明 $n+1,n+2$ 中至少有一个数的六次方模 $p$ 也余 $1$。
bmo1-2025-q5.answer: If $n\equiv-1\pmod p$, then $n+2$ works. For $p\ge5$ every other possible minimal root satisfies $n^2+n+1\equiv0\pmod p$, in which case $n+1$ works.
bmo1-2025-q5.answerZh: 若 $n\equiv-1\pmod p$，则 $n+2$ 可取；对 $p\ge5$，其余可能的最小根都满足 $n^2+n+1\equiv0\pmod p$，此时 $n+1$ 可取。

methods.title: Pair the quadratic factors by shifting the variable
methods.titleZh: 用平移将两个二次因式配对
steps: For $p=2$ the first admissible integer is $3$ and $5$ works next. For $p=3$ it is $2$ and $4$ works. Now suppose $p\ge5$. Since $p-1$ has sixth power $1$ modulo $p$, we have $2\le n\le p-1$, and in particular $p\nmid n-1$.

Factor $x^6-1=(x-1)(x+1)(x^2+x+1)(x^2-x+1)$. At $x=n$ some factor is divisible by the prime $p$. If $p\mid n+1$, then $n+2\equiv1\pmod p$, as required. If $p\mid n^2+n+1$, note that $(n+1)^2-(n+1)+1=n^2+n+1$, so the factorisation at $x=n+1$ supplies another sixth root.

The remaining possible factor is $n^2-n+1$. But it equals $(n-1)^2+(n-1)+1$, so its vanishing would make $n-1$ another sixth root. By minimality this forces $n-1=1$. Then the factor is $3$, impossible for $p\ge5$. Together these cases prove the claim.
stepsZh: 若 $p=2$，第一个符合条件的数是 $3$，接下来的 $5$ 也符合；若 $p=3$，第一个是 $2$，而 $4$ 也符合。以下设 $p\ge5$。因为 $p-1$ 的六次方模 $p$ 余 $1$，所以 $2\le n\le p-1$，特别地 $p\nmid n-1$。
分解 $x^6-1=(x-1)(x+1)(x^2+x+1)(x^2-x+1)$。代入 $x=n$ 后必有某个因子被素数 $p$ 整除。若 $p\mid n+1$，则 $n+2\equiv1\pmod p$，已满足结论。若 $p\mid n^2+n+1$，由 $(n+1)^2-(n+1)+1=n^2+n+1$，在 $x=n+1$ 时有一个因式被 $p$ 整除，故找到了另一个六次单位根。
剩下的可能因子是 $n^2-n+1$。然而它等于 $(n-1)^2+(n-1)+1$，故若它模 $p$ 为零，$n-1$ 的六次方也模 $p$ 余 $1$。由 $n$ 的最小性只能有 $n-1=1$，此时该因子等于 $3$，与 $p\ge5$ 矛盾。所有情形均已涵盖。

bmo1-2025-q6.summary: A $4\times4\times4$ solid is built from unit cubes of three possible flavours. Prove that some flavour has twelve cubes that can be grouped into six disjoint pairs, with the same centre-to-centre distance in every pair.
bmo1-2025-q6.summaryZh: 用三种口味的单位方糖堆成一个 $4\times4\times4$ 的大立方体。证明可选出同一种口味的十二块方糖，将它们分成六个互不重叠的数对，使每对方糖的中心距离都相等。
bmo1-2025-q6.answer: The six pairs can always be chosen at distance $\sqrt2$.
bmo1-2025-q6.answerZh: 总能使这六对方糖的中心距离均为 $\sqrt2$。

methods.title: Partition the centres into sixteen regular tetrahedra
methods.titleZh: 将中心分成十六组正四面体顶点
steps: Partition the large cube into eight $2\times2\times2$ blocks. In one block, use coordinates $0,1$ for the two possible centre positions along each axis. Group the eight binary triples by the parity of their coordinate sum. There are four centres in either group.

Two different triples of the same parity differ in exactly two coordinates: the number of differences is even, positive, and at most three. Thus any two different centres in that group are at distance $\sqrt{1^2+1^2}=\sqrt2$. The entire solid is now partitioned into $16$ such four-centre groups.

With only three flavours available, each group contains two cubes of the same flavour. Choose one such pair in each group. These $16$ pairs are disjoint and all have the same distance. If every flavour supplied at most five pairs there would be at most $15$ pairs; some flavour therefore supplies at least six. Select any six of that flavour.
stepsZh: 把大立方体分成八个 $2\times2\times2$ 小块。在一个小块内，每个坐标方向上两个可能的中心位置分别记为 $0,1$，于是八个中心对应八组三元组。按三个坐标之和的奇偶性分成两组，每组四个。
同组两个不同三元组恰有两个坐标不同：不同坐标数必须为正偶数，且不超过三。因此同组任两中心的距离都为 $\sqrt{1^2+1^2}=\sqrt2$。这样，整个大立方体的中心被分成 $16$ 个互不相交的四点组。
每组四块方糖只有三种口味，至少两块同味；在每组任选这样的一对。由各组互不相交，所得 $16$ 对都不重叠，且对内中心距离相同。如果每种口味至多有五对，则总数至多 $15$，矛盾。因此至少一种口味占六对或更多，选其中六对即可。
